Short Description: Fall back, Shoot and Charge
Long Description: This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Short Description:
Once per turn: Fight, when selected to fight or when targeted.
- +1 S melee
- or +1 T
Long Description:
Once per turn, per unit: In the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight or when an enemy unit targets this unit, you can select one of the following:
- This unit’s melee attacks have +1 S.
- This unit has +1 T.

Short Description: SUSTAIN HITS 1
Long Description:
Weapons equipped by models in this unit have
the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Short Description: Leading = Unit re-rolls the Hit roll.
Long Description: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Short Description: Unit gains [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
Long Description: While this model is leading a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Short Description:
Shoot an enemy, then, in MELEE, 
ALL Tyranids have extra -1 AP
Long Description: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the turn, each time a friendly Tyranids unit makes a melee attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. The same enemy unit can only be affected by this ability once per turn.

Short Description:
Lost a wound to ANY shots.
Move D6+2" to CLOSEST Enemy
Ok to end in Engagement.
Long Description:
Each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot, after that unit has shot, if any models from this unit lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks, this unit can make a Blistering Assault move. 

If it does, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result: each model in this unit can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but this unit must finish that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit. 

When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. Each unit can only make one Blistering Assault move per phase.

Short Description: Advance and Charge.
Long Description: This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Short Description: Termagant 6" RANGED have [LETHAL HITS]
Long Description: While a friendly Termagants unit is within 6" of this model, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Short Description: Hit enemy loses Benefit of Cover this Shooting phase.
Long Description: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

Short Description: If destroyed by - and if it has not fought, roll one D6: on a 4+, it can fight before it's removed.
Long Description: If this model is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Short Description: At the end of enemy turn, if not within Engagement, remove from battlefield and place into Strategic Reserves.
Long Description: At the end of your opponent’s turn, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Short Description: In Shooting, after shooting, select one enemy to take Battle-shock with -1.
Long Description: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

Short Description: Overwatch on 5+ or 4+ if on objective.
Long Description: Each time you target this unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, while resolving that Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+, or unmodified Hit rolls of 4+ instead if this unit is within range of an objective marker.

Short Description: 9" have Synapse
Long Description: While a friendly Tyranids unit is within 9" of this model, that unit is within your army’s Synapse Range.

Short Description: Enemy 6": -1 to Hit. If Below Half-strength, -1 to Wound.
Long Description: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll, and, if that enemy unit is Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from the Wound roll as well.

Short Description:
While within 6", enemy is LD -1.
Also, if below Starting strength, take battle-shock test in enemy Command Phase
Long Description:
While an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1.

In addition, in the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, if such an enemy unit is below its Starting Strength, it must take a Battle-shock test.

Short Description: When this model destroys a Character, you gain 1CP.
Long Description: Each time this model destroys an enemy Character model, you gain 1CP.

Short Description:
Each Melee vs a unit below its Starting Strength, add +1 To Hit.

If target is also Below Half-strength, add +1 To Wound.
Long Description:
Each time this model makes a - attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. 

If that target is also Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

Short Description: Enemy (not TITANIC) in Engagement trying to Fall Back: 3+ they Remain Stationary.
Long Description: Each time an enemy unit (excluding TITANIC units) within Engagement Range of one or more units from your army with this ability is selected to Fall Back, you can roll one D6: on a 3+, that enemy unit must Remain Stationary instead.

Short Description: Destroy a model, all take battle shock within 6"
Long Description: Each time this model is selected to fight, after resolving its attacks, if one or more enemy units were destroyed by those attacks, each enemy unit within 6" of this model must take a Battle-shock test.

Short Description: Led CHARACTER has Feel No Pain 5+.
Long Description: While a CHARACTER model is leading this unit, that CHARACTER has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

Short Description: At start of Command Phase, gain 1 CP.
Long Description: At the start of your Command phase, if this model is on the battlefield, you gain 1CP.

Short Description: Free Rapid Ingress and Free Heroic Intervention even if already used the stratagem
Long Description: Once per battle round, you can target this unit with the Rapid Ingress or Heroic Intervention Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this turn.

Short Description: End of Movement: each enemy 6" takes MW (2-3: 1, 4-5: D3, 6: D6).
Long Description: At the end of your Movement phase, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of this model: on a 2-3, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 4-5, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

Short Description: Fight phase, select enemy within Engagement Range: -1 To Hit.
Long Description: At the start of the Fight phase, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Short Description:
Leading Genestealers:
- Re-roll Hit rolls of 1.
- Target on objective: re-roll Wound rolls of 1.
Long Description: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the target is within range of one or more objective markers, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.

Short Description: 12" cost +1 CP
Long Description: If this model is your WARLORD, each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

Short Description: Battleshock within12"
Long Description: In your Command phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of this model. That unit must take a Battle-shock test.

Short Description: Extends Synapse
Long Description: While this unit is within Synapse Range of a friendly TYRANIDS unit (excluding NEUROGAUNT units), it has the SYNAPSE keyword.

Short Description: In Command, select 2 units within 18", they will stay in synapse.
Long Description: In your Command phase, you can select up to two friendly TYRANIDS units within 18" of this model’s unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, the selected units are always considered to be within Synapse Range of your army.

Short Description:
Leading = +1 To Hit.
Target Battle-shocked = +1 To Wound.
Long Description: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the target is Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

Short Description: Friendly 6": ranged weapons have [ASSAULT] and [LETHAL HITS].
Long Description: While a friendly TYRANIDS unit is within 6" of this model, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] and [LETHAL HITS] abilities.

Short Description: Start of Fight, select enemy within 12" and visible. Roll D6: on a 1, this Psyker suffers D3 mortal; 2+, until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from the Attacks of weapons in that unit.
Long Description: At the start of the Fight phase, you can select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to this model and roll one D6: on a 1, this Psyker suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 2+, until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of weapons equipped by models in that unit.

Short Description: Once per battle round, Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP.
Long Description: Once per battle round, you can target one model with this ability with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP.

Short Description: Heroic Intervention any number of times this phase. That use is -1 CP.
Long Description:
You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that Stratagem this phase. If you do:
- That use is -1 CP.
- That use does not prevent any uses of that Stratagem on other units this phase.

Short Description: If a Neurotyrant is on the battlefield, Shadow in the Warp, subtract -1 from the Battle-shock test of enemy.
Long Description: If one or more models from your army with this ability are on the battlefield when you unleash the Shadow in the Warp, subtract 1 from the Battle-shock test each enemy unit on the battlefield must take as a result.

Short Description: If Battleshock: -1 from Hit rolls, +1 To Wound them
Long Description:
While an enemy unit is within 12" of this model, if that unit is Battle-shocked:
- Each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
- Each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets that unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Short Description:

Prime Claws and talons

Prime Wounds = 6

Short Description: Once per Battle, Damage is 0
Long Description: Once per battle, when an attack is allocated to this model, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

Short Description: Instead of Shooting, set up a Spore mine anywhere within 48" and 8" away from enemy.
Long Description: Once per turn, in your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot, one unit with this ability can use it instead of making any attacks with its ranged weapons. If it does, you can add one new SPORE MINES unit to your army and set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 48" of this unit and more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units. That SPORE MINES unit contains 1 model for each model in this unit.

Short Description: Move through terrain; can move on RUINS floors if base does not overhang
Long Description: This model can move through terrain features, but cannot end a move within a wall, a floor, etc. This model can be set up or end a move on any floor level of RUINS, but if that level is not the ground floor, it can only do so if its base does not overhang the floor at that level.

Short Description: Pick an enemy unit (re-roll Hit/Wound vs it) or an objective (FNP 5+ and OC 15 on it).
Long Description:
At the start of the first battle round, select one of the following:
- Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the battle, each time this model makes an attack that targets that unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
- Select one objective marker. Until the end of the battle, while this model is within range of that objective marker, it has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability and an Objective Control characteristic of 15.

Short Description: Enemy ends a move within 8": if unengaged, Normal move D6".
Long Description: In your opponent’s Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Short Description: Command Phase: Termagaunts 6" generate D3+3
Long Description: In your Command phase, you can select one friendly Termagants unit within 6" of this model and return up to D3+3 destroyed Termagant models to that unit. A Termagants unit cannot be selected for this ability more than once per phase.

Short Description: Enemy 6" fails Battle-shock: D3 mortal wounds and this unit regains D3.
Long Description: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, if this unit contains a Neurothrope, each time that enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test, it suffers D3 mortal wounds and one model in this unit regains up to D3 lost wounds.

Floating Death: Each time an enemy unit ends a move within 3" of a model in this unit, and each time a model in this unit ends a move within 3" of an enemy unit, roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Short Description: End of Fight: if not in Engagement, go to Strategic Reserves
Long Description: At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Short Description: Deep Strike more than 6". Cannot charge this turn.
Long Description:
In your Movement phase, when this model is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, it can use a subterranean tunnel.

If it does, this model can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, but until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.

Short Description: Critical Wounds vs INFANTRY, MOUNTED or BEASTS; regain D3+2 wounds
Long Description: Each time an attack with this model’s gaping maw targets an INFANTRY, MOUNTED or BEASTS unit, each successful unmodified Wound roll is a Critical Wound. Each time an INFANTRY, MOUNTED or BEASTS model is destroyed as a result of an attack made by this model’s gaping maw, this model regains up to D3+2 lost wounds.

Short Description: After this model shoots, friendly Tyranids re-roll Hit 1s vs that enemy.
Long Description: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets that unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

Short Description: Deep Strike: each enemy 12" takes D3 MW (2-4) or 3 MW + Battle-shock (5+).
Long Description: Each time this model is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 12" of this model: on a 2-4, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5+, that unit suffers 3 mortal wounds and must take a Battle-shock test.

Short Description: Trygon Prime  Enhancement included in points and weapon profiles.
Long Description: Trygon Prime  Enhancement included in points and weapon profiles. Including the CHARACTER, SYNAPSE +1 WS and +1 Strength.

Short Description: Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.
Long Description: This model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

Short Description: EACH Command, regain D3 wounds.
Long Description: At the start of each player’s Command phase, this model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

Short Description:
Re-roll To Hit of 1.
Target on obj, re-roll To Wound of 1
Long Description:
Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. 
If the target is within range of one or more objective markers, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.

Short Description: Leading. Unit has [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
Long Description: While this model is leading a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

Short Description: Friendly 6" have 6++
Long Description: While a friendly TYRANIDS unit is within 6" of this unit, models in that unit have a 6+ invulnerable save.

Short Description: Once per battle round, units within 12" have -1 CP cost.
Long Description: Once per battle round, one model from your army with this ability can use it when a friendly Tyranids unit within 12" of that model is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP

Short Description: After shooting, if unengaged: Normal move 6". Cannot charge that turn.
Long Description: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, if it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". If it does, until the end of the turn, this unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

Short Description: Once per turn, enemy that Falls Back from Engagement: 2+ suffers D6 mortal wounds.
Long Description: Once per turn, when an enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model is selected to Fall Back, roll one D6: on a 2+, that unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

Short Description: Friendly TYRANIDS within 6" have Stealth.
Long Description: Friendly TYRANIDS units within 6" of this unit have the Stealth ability.
